short_description: Consumer-facing lifestyle trait that reports a cautious panel-relative signal for usual walking-pace tendency within the current local reference panel.
summary_note: Usable consumer-facing lifestyle trait describing a cautious inherited signal related to usual walking pace relative to the current local reference panel.
what_it_measures: A panel-relative polygenic signal associated with the bundled usual-walking-pace score, calibrated within the current local empirical reference panel.
interpretation_template: This is a cautious panel-relative lifestyle signal, not a direct measurement of your current walking speed. {interpretation}
caution_text: Use as a cautious panel-relative signal only. No imputation or ancestry-adjusted normalization is used, and the output should not be treated as a direct readout of current walking speed, fitness level, gait quality, or mobility health.
limitations: Percentiles and z-scores are relative to the local reference panel, not to a population-wide benchmark.
Current walking pace depends strongly on age, training, injury, pain, body composition, motivation, environment, and health status.
This trait should not be used as a mobility assessment or medical interpretation.
confidence_note: Confidence reflects overlap and reference robustness under the no-imputation raw-array workflow, not certainty about the real-world trait.
reference_note: Percentiles and z-scores are calibrated against a local empirical reference artifact built from raw-array files in this project; they are panel-relative, not population-wide.
